source_claim: SEGA's official character pages for Yakuza 7, Yakuza 4, Yakuza 3, Yakuza Kiwami, and Yakuza: Of the End explicitly identify every named campaign character as appearing in an official entry of the Like a Dragon/Yakuza series.
notes: SEGA's official Yakuza 7 character page profiles Kasuga Ichiban, Mukoda Saeko, Adachi Koichi, Han Joon-gi, and Zhao Tianyou (https://www.sega.jp/game/detail/ryu-ga-gotoku_seven/), describing the game as an entry in the Like a Dragon series. The official Yakuza 4 page names Kiryu Kazuma, Akiyama Shun, Saejima Taiga, and Dojima Daigo as its principal protagonists and characters (https://www.sega.jp/game/detail/ryu-ga-gotoku-four/). SEGA's Yakuza 3 page profiles Mine Yoshitaka (https://www.sega.jp/game/detail/ryu-ga-gotoku-three/). SEGA's Yakuza Kiwami page identifies Kiryu Kazuma and Nishikiyama Akira among its central characters (https://www.sega.jp/game/detail/ryu-ga-gotoku-kiwami/). SEGA's Yakuza: Of the End page gives character profiles for Majima Goro and also identifies the title as a Yakuza series game (https://www.sega.jp/game/detail/ryu-ga-gotoku-theend/). Each campaign member is directly named in an official Sega game entry belonging to the series; the relation uses the series copyright root rather than assigning one appearance's game as each character's only work.
